Most people think your heart is on the left side of your chest.
It sits behind your breastbone, near the middle of your chest.
It just leans left, so its tip points down to the left.
That tip is the beat you can feel.
And that matters if you ever need to do CPR.
Don't push on the left side.
Push hard on the lower half of the breastbone.
Each push squeezes your heart and chest against your spine,
and pushes blood out to the brain.
Push about two times a second, until help comes.
